description: Given one identifier (ticker, SEC CIK, LEI, FIGI, SEC fund series or class id, FinancialMD id, or a CUSIP or ISIN you already hold), return the company or fund it names and the other open identifiers we hold for it, each with its source and licence. A CUSIP or ISIN is matched only against values that filers reported in public SEC filings, and the answer names the filing; CUSIP and ISIN values are not returned, because those numbering systems are licensed. Check digits are not computed and missing identifiers are never filled in from a vendor source. Use it to join FinancialMD data to another system or to find out what an identifier refers to.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

id.description: The identifier, e.g. AAPL, 0000320193, HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394, BBG000B9XRY4, S000002839.

kind.description: What the identifier is; omit to detect it from its shape.

name: identifier_xref

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { query { kind, value, detected }, matched_on, matches: [{ type, company, fund, identifiers: [{ kind, value, basis, source { id, licence, terms_url } }], withheld }], note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Cross-reference a security identifier
